headline: Mexico's GDP slowed in Q3 2026, growing 0.9% quarter-on-quarter
summary: Mexico's economy grew 0.9% quarter on quarter in July-September, with annual growth of 3.3%, the strongest rebound since 2023. The quarterly pace is described as a slowdown.
why: GDP data guides central-bank policy, peso expectations and the outlook for Mexico-exposed equities and bonds.
original_headline: PIB de México se desaceleró en el III Trim del 2026, creció 0.9% trimestral
